population: All certified_estimated neutral actions, strict subset separately; filled subsets diagnostic only
classes: no fill, positive-value fill, negative-value fill, zero-value fill; material subset >=0.5c/share absolute value
features: All 83 inputs plus fair_deficit, fair_shock_over_edge, bn50_shock_over_edge, bn250_shock_over_edge, micro_deficit
binning: Four early days, five all-action quantile bins plus missing; direction chosen on early good/bad fills, raw direction always reported
conditional_auc: pair weighted within day/side/rung/floor(edge)/P(fill) bands .05,.1,.2,.4; finer version adds hour; coverage reported
economic_control: Exact analytic expected selected value within day/hour/side/rung/exact known remaining/floor(edge)/P(fill) bands/feature availability; no sampled null or p value
multiplicity: 88 inputs/scores and four fixed logical diagnostics, all reported; no winner promoted
lineage: Rebuild all model inputs from stored event-derived feature rows and client-known action states. Exact timestamps, keys, signs/scales, source labels. Preserve prior raw-recomputation receipt; no collector-tape rebuild.
controls: Known good/bad/no-fill categorization; reject nonzero no-fill value; rank oracle and confounded matched AUC; bid/ask economic identity; corrupted saved predictions refused
compute: Codex slot core8, 2GiB RSS guard; nine consumed dates only
